newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Tietmeyer renamed G10 central bank committee head.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer renamed G10 central bank committee head.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said he was reappointed chairman of the central bank governors committee of the Group of 10 (G10) countries.
Tietmeyer told reporters after the committee's monthly meeting at the Bank for International Settlements in Basle that the other governors had asked him to serve a second three-year term.
Tietmeyer also said the governors reappointed William McDonough, president of the New York Federal Reserve, as chairman of the G10's committee on payment and settlement systems.
Tietmeyer was first appointed chairman of the central bank governors committee in January 1994. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 631 7340
